description.message: Tells the RoundDigital Track desktop app which website you are on during a work session — the domain only, and only if your organization's policy records it.

stateSharing.message: A work session is recording website domains: the site in front (e.g. github.com) is shared with the desktop app.

stateIdle.message: Nothing is shared right now. Domains are shared only during a work session whose policy records them.

stateNoApp.message: The RoundDigital Track desktop app isn't installed or running on this computer, so nothing is shared.

popupPrivacy.message: Only the domain ever leaves this browser — never the page, its address, its content or what you type. Private windows are never looked at.
